title: Goku's Five Strongest Dragon Ball Forms
summary:
Dragon Ball is one of the most famous anime series in the world. Akira Toriyama created it more than 40 years ago. Its hero, Goku, is always hungry, works hard and keeps getting stronger. A writer for the website /Film ranked Goku's five strongest forms.

Number five is Super Saiyan God. Goku cannot reach it alone. Five Saiyans must share their energy, called ki, with him. His hair and eyes turn red.

Number four is Super Saiyan Blue Kaio-ken. It is very strong, but it left Goku weak and tired for days.

Number three is Super Saiyan Blue. Goku's hair and eyes turn bright blue, and he glows with electricity.

Number two is Ultra Instinct Sign. Goku's eyes turn silver, and he can dodge attacks without much thought.

Number one is Perfected Ultra Instinct. It needs a very calm mind. The writer says Goku can keep training it, so its power may have no limit.
why_it_matters: Goku shows that training hard and staying calm can help you keep getting better at something you love.
